messages:
anya: Heads-up: proposal to add an "Estimated units" pill on Embed Route pages so console shows potential oversize before users submit.

phil: Good idea. We already compute preflight ests via X-Embed-Preflight. We can return `est_units`, `est_confidence`, and a short `split_label` for UI.

maria: UX: show friendly text ("~14 units · medium confidence · may split into 3 chunks") and a "Show fix" button with client SDK snippet. No raw JSON.

jamie: Runtime note: avoid scanning full payload in Console path. Do sample-first heuristic (N=3) and mark low confidence if variance high; background full scan for metrics.

phil: Telemetry: emit `embed.preflight.estimated_units` and `embed.preflight.prediction_error` tagged by route and confidence; avoid tenant-level cardinality.

ingest-bot: ingest-bot: staging test vectors are at /staging/embed-testvectors for canary runs.

anya: Rollout: dark launch to 5%, compare predicted vs actual units p50/p90; auto-rollback if median error > 20% for 1h or 413 regressions rise. Owners: @jamie rollback, @phil telemetry, @maria UI, @anya console mock.
